title: GET /api/v1/users/:username/stats, 200 without total_seconds=true
description: StatsController#user_stats (stats_controller.rb lines 32-113) returns WakatimeService#build_summary (wakatime_service.rb lines 72-110) as data, adds streak and sometimes unique_total_seconds, and appends the masked trust level. With total_seconds=true the body is stats_total_seconds.schema.json instead.

username.description: User#display_name (user.rb lines 400-408), which always returns a string.

user_id.description: The numeric user id, as a string.

total_seconds.description: With test_param=true, Heartbeat.duration_seconds_boundary_aware over the filtered heartbeats in one global order, counting the gap from the last heartbeat before start (heartbeatable.rb lines 286-311). Otherwise plain duration_seconds over start <= time < end (lines 279-283).

daily_average.description: total_seconds divided by the whole days from start to end. Both divisions are integer divisions, and the value is 0 for a window under a day.

projects.description: Present when features includes projects. One entry per project name with heartbeats in start <= time < end, sorted by total_seconds descending and cut to limit when limit is non-zero. The seconds come from the grouped path, where LAG is partitioned by project (heartbeatable.rb lines 255-277), and that path never adds the boundary heartbeat. Entries can therefore add up to more than total_seconds (HC 1.4).

languages.description: Present when features includes languages, which is the default when features is absent.

unique_total_seconds.description: Present when features includes projects and filter_by_project is set. Coding-category heartbeats only, in one order, where a gap counts only when it is over 0 and at most 120 s (unique_heartbeat_seconds, stats_controller.rb lines 205-215).

second_z.description: Time.at(epoch).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'). Time.at uses the server process's zone, so the Z holds only when that zone is UTC.

detailed_text.description: short_time_detailed (application_helper.rb lines 52-56). Zero parts are left out, so 0 is the empty string.

simple_text.description: short_time_simple (application_helper.rb lines 45-50): hours and minutes, never seconds, and 0m for under a minute.

digital.description: digital_time (application_helper.rb lines 40-43): zero-padded hours, minutes and seconds.

name.description: The project or language as stored, or 'Other' for a null or empty one. Stardance drops 'Other' and '<<LAST_PROJECT>>' (stardance app/models/user/hackatime_project.rb line 38).

percent.description: (100.0 * total_seconds / data.total_seconds).round(2). By our reading this is null when data.total_seconds is 0, since the quotient isn't finite and Rails encodes non-finite floats as null.

public_trust_factor.description: @user.public_trust_level, which shows yellow as blue (user.rb lines 55-59), with its enum value.
